get.description: Public discovery for workspace sign-in: given an email, returns the workspaces whose SSO email-domain lists explicitly contain that domain, with the workspace name and provider preset. Workspaces without SSO configured or without the domain allowlisted never appear.

post.description: OIDC back-channel logout for a workspace: verifies the provider's signed logout_token against the workspace issuer (with multi-tenant issuer support), rejects replay by jti, and ends the sessions of the bound account. Provider-initiated; requires no user agent.

Back-channel logout for social sign-in providers that publish the standard logout event. GitHub and X do not support it and return 404; the token must verify against the configured provider issuer and carry an unused jti.

404.description: Provider absent, disabled or without logout support
